answer: Added `--category` to `tools/report.py` via argparse — it skips orders whose product category doesn't match, and is omitted entirely when not passed (all 2400 orders processed). Along the way I also fixed a pre-existing bug: the script called `shipping.ship_cost_for`, which doesn't exist (the module only defines `ship_cost`), so it crashed on every run regardless of `--category`.
